all_fields.name: capacity
all_fields.description: The sku of the instance. Valid values are "CU_1", "CU_2", "CU_4", "CU_8".

all_fields.name: child_instance_refs
all_fields.description:
The refs of the child instances. This is only available if the instance is
parent instance.

all_fields.name: creation_time
all_fields.description: The timestamp when the instance was created.

all_fields.name: creator
all_fields.description: The email of the creator of the instance.

all_fields.name: custom_tags
all_fields.description: Custom tags associated with the instance. This field is only included on create and update responses.

all_fields.name: effective_capacity
all_fields.description:
Deprecated. The sku of the instance; this field will always match the value of capacity.
This is an output only field that contains the value computed from the input field combined with
server side defaults. Use the field without the effective_ prefix to set the value.

all_fields.name: effective_custom_tags
all_fields.description:
The recorded custom tags associated with the instance.
This is an output only field that contains the value computed from the input field combined with
server side defaults. Use the field without the effective_ prefix to set the value.

all_fields.name: effective_enable_pg_native_login
all_fields.description:
Whether the instance has PG native password login enabled.
This is an output only field that contains the value computed from the input field combined with
server side defaults. Use the field without the effective_ prefix to set the value.

all_fields.name: effective_enable_readable_secondaries
all_fields.description:
Whether secondaries serving read-only traffic are enabled. Defaults to false.
This is an output only field that contains the value computed from the input field combined with
server side defaults. Use the field without the effective_ prefix to set the value.

all_fields.name: effective_node_count
all_fields.description:
The number of nodes in the instance, composed of 1 primary and 0 or more secondaries. Defaults to
1 primary and 0 secondaries.
This is an output only field that contains the value computed from the input field combined with
server side defaults. Use the field without the effective_ prefix to set the value.

all_fields.name: effective_retention_window_in_days
all_fields.description:
The retention window for the instance. This is the time window in days
for which the historical data is retained.
This is an output only field that contains the value computed from the input field combined with
server side defaults. Use the field without the effective_ prefix to set the value.

all_fields.name: effective_stopped
all_fields.description:
Whether the instance is stopped.
This is an output only field that contains the value computed from the input field combined with
server side defaults. Use the field without the effective_ prefix to set the value.

all_fields.name: effective_usage_policy_id
all_fields.description:
The policy that is applied to the instance.
This is an output only field that contains the value computed from the input field combined with
server side defaults. Use the field without the effective_ prefix to set the value.

all_fields.name: enable_pg_native_login
all_fields.description: Whether to enable PG native password login on the instance. Defaults to false.

all_fields.name: enable_readable_secondaries
all_fields.description: Whether to enable secondaries to serve read-only traffic. Defaults to false.

all_fields.name: name
all_fields.description: The name of the instance. This is the unique identifier for the instance.

all_fields.name: node_count
all_fields.description:
The number of nodes in the instance, composed of 1 primary and 0 or more secondaries. Defaults to
1 primary and 0 secondaries. This field is input only, see effective_node_count for the output.

all_fields.name: parent_instance_ref
all_fields.description:
The ref of the parent instance. This is only available if the instance is
child instance.
Input: For specifying the parent instance to create a child instance. Optional.
Output: Only populated if provided as input to create a child instance.

all_fields.name: pg_version
all_fields.description: The version of Postgres running on the instance.

all_fields.name: read_only_dns
all_fields.description:
The DNS endpoint to connect to the instance for read only access. This is only available if
enable_readable_secondaries is true.

all_fields.name: read_write_dns
all_fields.description: The DNS endpoint to connect to the instance for read+write access.

all_fields.name: retention_window_in_days
all_fields.description:
The retention window for the instance. This is the time window in days
for which the historical data is retained. The default value is 7 days.
Valid values are 2 to 35 days.

all_fields.name: state
all_fields.description: The current state of the instance.

all_fields.name: stopped
all_fields.description: Whether to stop the instance. An input only param, see effective_stopped for the output.

all_fields.name: uid
all_fields.description: An immutable UUID identifier for the instance.

all_fields.name: usage_policy_id
all_fields.description: The desired usage policy to associate with the instance.

required_positional_arguments.name: name
required_positional_arguments.description: The name of the instance. This is the unique identifier for the instance.

all_fields.name: database_instance_name
all_fields.description:
Name of the target database instance. This is required when creating synced database tables in standard catalogs.
This is optional when creating synced database tables in registered catalogs. If this field is specified
when creating synced database tables in registered catalogs, the database instance name MUST
match that of the registered catalog (or the request will be rejected).

all_fields.name: effective_database_instance_name
all_fields.description:
The name of the database instance that this table is registered to. This field is always returned, and for
tables inside database catalogs is inferred database instance associated with the catalog.
This is an output only field that contains the value computed from the input field combined with
server side defaults. Use the field without the effective_ prefix to set the value.

all_fields.name: effective_logical_database_name
all_fields.description:
The name of the logical database that this table is registered to.
This is an output only field that contains the value computed from the input field combined with
server side defaults. Use the field without the effective_ prefix to set the value.

all_fields.name: logical_database_name
all_fields.description:
Target Postgres database object (logical database) name for this table.

When creating a synced table in a registered Postgres catalog, the
target Postgres database name is inferred to be that of the registered catalog.
If this field is specified in this scenario, the Postgres database name MUST
match that of the registered catalog (or the request will be rejected).

When creating a synced table in a standard catalog, this field is required.
In this scenario, specifying this field will allow targeting an arbitrary postgres database.
Note that this has implications for the `create_database_objects_is_missing` field in `spec`.

all_fields.name: name
all_fields.description: Full three-part (catalog, schema, table) name of the table.

all_fields.name: unity_catalog_provisioning_state
all_fields.description:
The provisioning state of the synced table entity in Unity Catalog. This is distinct from the
state of the data synchronization pipeline (i.e. the table may be in "ACTIVE" but the pipeline
may be in "PROVISIONING" as it runs asynchronously).

required_positional_arguments.name: name
required_positional_arguments.description: Full three-part (catalog, schema, table) name of the table.

methods.summary: Generates a credential that can be used to access database instances.
methods.cli_launch_stage_banner: This command is in Public Preview and may change without notice.

all_fields.name: claims
all_fields.description:
A set of UC permissions to add to the credential. We verify that the caller has the necessary
permissions in UC and include a reference in the token. Postgres uses that token to give the
connecting user additional grants to the Postgres resources that correspond to the UC resources.
The UC resources need to be something that have a Postgres counterpart. For example, a synced table or
a table in a UC database catalog.

all_fields.name: instance_names
all_fields.description: Instances to request a credential for. At least one of instance_names or claims must be specified.

methods.name: UpdateDatabaseInstance
methods.description:
Update a Database Instance.

For new workloads, Databricks recommends the Postgres API equivalents:
[Update a project](https://docs.databricks.com/api/postgres/v1/update-project) and
[Update an endpoint](https://docs.databricks.com/api/postgres/v1/update-endpoint).
methods.cli_launch_stage_banner: This command is in Public Preview and may change without notice.

required_fields.name: update_mask
required_fields.description:
The list of fields to update. If unspecified, all fields will be updated when possible. To wipe out custom_tags,
specify custom_tags in the update_mask with an empty custom_tags map.

all_fields.name: update_mask
all_fields.description:
The list of fields to update. If unspecified, all fields will be updated when possible. To wipe out custom_tags,
specify custom_tags in the update_mask with an empty custom_tags map.

all_fields.name: capacity
all_fields.description: The sku of the instance. Valid values are "CU_1", "CU_2", "CU_4", "CU_8".

all_fields.name: child_instance_refs
all_fields.description:
The refs of the child instances. This is only available if the instance is
parent instance.

all_fields.name: creation_time
all_fields.description: The timestamp when the instance was created.

all_fields.name: creator
all_fields.description: The email of the creator of the instance.

all_fields.name: custom_tags
all_fields.description: Custom tags associated with the instance. This field is only included on create and update responses.

all_fields.name: effective_capacity
all_fields.description:
Deprecated. The sku of the instance; this field will always match the value of capacity.
This is an output only field that contains the value computed from the input field combined with
server side defaults. Use the field without the effective_ prefix to set the value.

all_fields.name: effective_custom_tags
all_fields.description:
The recorded custom tags associated with the instance.
This is an output only field that contains the value computed from the input field combined with
server side defaults. Use the field without the effective_ prefix to set the value.

all_fields.name: effective_enable_pg_native_login
all_fields.description:
Whether the instance has PG native password login enabled.
This is an output only field that contains the value computed from the input field combined with
server side defaults. Use the field without the effective_ prefix to set the value.

all_fields.name: effective_enable_readable_secondaries
all_fields.description:
Whether secondaries serving read-only traffic are enabled. Defaults to false.
This is an output only field that contains the value computed from the input field combined with
server side defaults. Use the field without the effective_ prefix to set the value.

all_fields.name: effective_node_count
all_fields.description:
The number of nodes in the instance, composed of 1 primary and 0 or more secondaries. Defaults to
1 primary and 0 secondaries.
This is an output only field that contains the value computed from the input field combined with
server side defaults. Use the field without the effective_ prefix to set the value.

all_fields.name: effective_retention_window_in_days
all_fields.description:
The retention window for the instance. This is the time window in days
for which the historical data is retained.
This is an output only field that contains the value computed from the input field combined with
server side defaults. Use the field without the effective_ prefix to set the value.

all_fields.name: effective_stopped
all_fields.description:
Whether the instance is stopped.
This is an output only field that contains the value computed from the input field combined with
server side defaults. Use the field without the effective_ prefix to set the value.

all_fields.name: effective_usage_policy_id
all_fields.description:
The policy that is applied to the instance.
This is an output only field that contains the value computed from the input field combined with
server side defaults. Use the field without the effective_ prefix to set the value.

all_fields.name: enable_pg_native_login
all_fields.description: Whether to enable PG native password login on the instance. Defaults to false.

all_fields.name: enable_readable_secondaries
all_fields.description: Whether to enable secondaries to serve read-only traffic. Defaults to false.

all_fields.name: name
all_fields.description: The name of the instance. This is the unique identifier for the instance.

all_fields.name: node_count
all_fields.description:
The number of nodes in the instance, composed of 1 primary and 0 or more secondaries. Defaults to
1 primary and 0 secondaries. This field is input only, see effective_node_count for the output.

all_fields.name: parent_instance_ref
all_fields.description:
The ref of the parent instance. This is only available if the instance is
child instance.
Input: For specifying the parent instance to create a child instance. Optional.
Output: Only populated if provided as input to create a child instance.

all_fields.name: pg_version
all_fields.description: The version of Postgres running on the instance.

all_fields.name: read_only_dns
all_fields.description:
The DNS endpoint to connect to the instance for read only access. This is only available if
enable_readable_secondaries is true.

all_fields.name: read_write_dns
all_fields.description: The DNS endpoint to connect to the instance for read+write access.

all_fields.name: retention_window_in_days
all_fields.description:
The retention window for the instance. This is the time window in days
for which the historical data is retained. The default value is 7 days.
Valid values are 2 to 35 days.

all_fields.name: state
all_fields.description: The current state of the instance.

all_fields.name: stopped
all_fields.description: Whether to stop the instance. An input only param, see effective_stopped for the output.

all_fields.name: uid
all_fields.description: An immutable UUID identifier for the instance.

all_fields.name: usage_policy_id
all_fields.description: The desired usage policy to associate with the instance.

all_fields.description: Synced Table data synchronization status

all_fields.name: database_instance_name
all_fields.description:
Name of the target database instance. This is required when creating synced database tables in standard catalogs.
This is optional when creating synced database tables in registered catalogs. If this field is specified
when creating synced database tables in registered catalogs, the database instance name MUST
match that of the registered catalog (or the request will be rejected).

all_fields.name: effective_database_instance_name
all_fields.description:
The name of the database instance that this table is registered to. This field is always returned, and for
tables inside database catalogs is inferred database instance associated with the catalog.
This is an output only field that contains the value computed from the input field combined with
server side defaults. Use the field without the effective_ prefix to set the value.

all_fields.name: effective_logical_database_name
all_fields.description:
The name of the logical database that this table is registered to.
This is an output only field that contains the value computed from the input field combined with
server side defaults. Use the field without the effective_ prefix to set the value.

all_fields.name: logical_database_name
all_fields.description:
Target Postgres database object (logical database) name for this table.

When creating a synced table in a registered Postgres catalog, the
target Postgres database name is inferred to be that of the registered catalog.
If this field is specified in this scenario, the Postgres database name MUST
match that of the registered catalog (or the request will be rejected).

When creating a synced table in a standard catalog, this field is required.
In this scenario, specifying this field will allow targeting an arbitrary postgres database.
Note that this has implications for the `create_database_objects_is_missing` field in `spec`.

all_fields.name: name
all_fields.description: Full three-part (catalog, schema, table) name of the table.

all_fields.name: unity_catalog_provisioning_state
all_fields.description:
The provisioning state of the synced table entity in Unity Catalog. This is distinct from the
state of the data synchronization pipeline (i.e. the table may be in "ACTIVE" but the pipeline
may be in "PROVISIONING" as it runs asynchronously).

required_positional_arguments.description: Full three-part (catalog, schema, table) name of the table.

required_positional_arguments.description: The list of fields to update. Setting this field is not yet supported.
